objectives: Resolver referencias pronominales y frases «the former/the latter».
Reconocer la función de conectores de contraste y consecuencia.
Elegir la paráfrasis fiel y descartar exageraciones.

words: Debt accumulates when payments are late.
to change to suit new conditions
Species must adapt to a warming climate.
to distribute for a specific purpose
The department allocated funds to research.
The survey showed a clear gender bias.
to reach a conclusion by reasoning
We can deduce the cause from the pattern.
to experience a change or process

practice.title: Microplastics (≈ 180 palabras)
practice.passage:
Microplastics, fragments smaller than five millimeters, have been found everywhere from mountain snow to deep-sea sediment. Some originate as larger items that gradually break apart; others, such as the tiny beads once added to cosmetics, are manufactured at that size. Although many countries have banned the latter, the former continue to accumulate.

The risks are not yet fully understood. Laboratory studies indicate that these particles can carry toxic chemicals, which then enter the food chain when small animals ingest them. Nevertheless, evidence of harm to humans remains inconclusive, partly because measuring exposure is difficult.

Researchers therefore disagree about priorities. Some argue that cleanup should come first, whereas others contend that preventing new pollution is far more efficient, since removing particles from oceans is extremely costly. The second group points out that filters installed in washing machines already capture a significant share of synthetic fibers.

items.explain: «the latter» = el último de los dos elementos mencionados: las microperlas fabricadas (manufactured at that size).

options: a contrast with the previous idea
items.explain: Nevertheless introduce un contraste: aunque pueden transportar químicos tóxicos, la evidencia en humanos no es concluyente.

items.q: Which sentence best expresses the essential information of the sentence "Laboratory studies indicate that these particles can carry toxic chemicals, which then enter the food chain when small animals ingest them"?
options: Small animals produce toxic chemicals that pollute laboratories.
Particles may transport harmful substances into food chains once animals swallow them.
Laboratories have proved that animals are poisoned by plastic.
Toxic chemicals are only found in small animals.
items.explain: Paráfrasis fiel: transportan sustancias dañinas y entran a la cadena alimentaria al ser ingeridas. C exagera («proved»).

items.q: The word "inconclusive" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
options: not leading to a firm conclusion
items.explain: inconclusive = que no permite sacar una conclusión firme.

items.q: What can be inferred about washing machine filters?
options: They support the argument that prevention is practical
They are banned in many countries
They are mainly used in cosmetics
items.explain: El segundo grupo los cita como prueba de que prevenir ya funciona; no «eliminan todo» (A exagera).

quiz.q: "Studies of sleep and memory are numerous. These have mostly used students as participants." "These" refers to
quiz.explain: El pronombre demostrativo apunta al sustantivo plural previo: studies.

quiz.q: "Few findings have been replicated" is closest to
options: Hardly any results have been confirmed by repetition.
quiz.explain: few = casi ninguno; replicated = repetido para confirmar.
